fields.headline: Westmarch Fresh recalls spring mix because of possible Listeria monocytogenes
fields.summary: Westmarch Fresh Distribution is recalling the packages listed below after a routine test of one lot was positive.
fields.reason: A routine sample from lot MLW-261104-A tested positive for Listeria monocytogenes.
fields.hazard: Listeria monocytogenes can cause serious infections in young children, frail or elderly people and others with weakened immune systems.
consumerActions: Do not eat the product. Throw it away or return it for a refund.
Wash surfaces and containers that touched it.
fields.illnesses: No illnesses have been reported to date.
fields.contact: (555) 010-9920, weekdays 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern, westmarch.example/recall
